profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer / TL
profile.summary:
Ivette is an experienced engineer with:
- Primary skillset:  Java, Spring (-core, mvc, batch, security, boot), Shell (primarily Bash) scripting, CI/CD tools (Jenkins), Linux servers, Javascript, REST APIs, Design Patterns, GIT, Scrum management and AWS ( EC2, S3, API Gateway, etc)

- Ancillary skillset: Python, Perl, jQuery, C#, Bootstrap

She has worked with teams in several roles, such as: 
-Developer, Scrum Master, Technical Leader, Production Support, and Developer Manager. 

She is involved in full SDLC and has worked using several implementations of agile methodology. 

She is currently in a Capital Markets project.

positions.title: Application Development Manager
positions.description:
Developing, designing and maintaining technologies that improve the way our client works. 
In this role I have performed as jr architect for the development of a flexible framework tailored for our client. Best practices in coding and the experience to foresee complications in the process were my two best skills during this project.
In a second phase of the project  I took over a senior developer for existing applications that will eventually use the framework created in the first phase.
As an application developer manager I have been more involved in planning and coordinating people and activities that relates to at least 5 applications  in the account

positions.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
As Sr Developer I moved around in different teams within the same account.
Major achievements were:
Developing a web application in expedite time using Spring Boot. This was an interfaced developed to provide profiling security and access to testers to generate mock data for several teams within the account. 
The application was developed as a REST application and the consumer was designed to be used as a Web application and a batch service.
Design, development, testing and deployment were under my supervision.

After the application was delivered and got stable in the production environment I moved to work with the team consuming the batch service.
High skills in unix environment, shells scripting, python, xml parsing, versioning tools were applied in the project.
Team size: 6 people.

positions.title: Sr Java Software Developer
positions.description:
Software Developer assigned to work for client to build batch applications using Java, Spring boot as main framework involving the modules Data, Security, Batch, MVC. 

A medium size team was self organized in 3 sub teams.
Code reviews and high standards of testing coverage were the key that allowed the project to succeed in time and budget.
Additional skills required: shell scripting, building application scripts, versioning and unix.
